title: FRENCH ARMY WORK JACKET
desc: DESCRIPTION Born in the workshops and fields of late 19th-century France, the chore jacket or bleu de travail is the ultimate expression of utilitarian design. Originally dyed a deep, vibrant indigo to mask the grease and grime of the Industrial Revolution, it served as the uniform of choice for the farmers, craftsmen, and laborers who built modern France. The design is purely intentional: a straight, boxy cut provides ease of movement, while the unlined construction ensures breathability during heavy labor. Made from lightweight cotton poplin, it features two symmetrical chest pockets with buttoned flaps, tonal buttons, and a straight hem. title: TACTICAL SWISS CAMO JACKET
desc: DESCRIPTION Constructed from durable cotton fabric, the jacket features a highly functional load bearing design with multiple utility pockets across the chest, sleeves, and waist. Large cargo pockets provide generous storage, while the zip front closure with snap storm flap offers protection against wind and harsh conditions. Reinforced construction and attachment loops further emphasize its practical military design. Recognizable by its distinctive Alpenflage camouflage and complex pocket layout, this Swiss Army field jacket remains one of the most iconic pieces of European military surplus.

title: UNIVERSAL HBT FATIGUE PANTS - NAVY BLUE
desc: DESCRIPTION Rooted in American military heritage, these fatigue pants are a faithful reproduction of the transitional model worn by the US Army just after World War II. Originally inspired by the Baker Pants, they were developed as the link between the utilitarian trousers of the 1940s and the OG-107 adopted in the early 1950s, marking the last major use of HBT (Herringbone Twill) fabric by the US military. title: SWEDISH ARMY GREEN POLO SHIRT
desc: DESCRIPTION The Swedish Army M59 Field Shirt ( Fältskjorta m/59 ) is an iconic piece of Cold War military design. Introduced in 1959 as part of Sweden’s standardized M59 uniform, this pop-over smock was purpose-built for the harsh demands of Scandinavian field operations. Designed for raw utility, it features a 1/4 button placket for easy layering and a long drop-tail hem engineered to stay tucked in during heavy movement. title: UNIVERSAL FRENCH ARMY M-47 CARGO PANTS

title: UNIVERSAL SAILOR WORK SHIRT - NATURAL
desc: DESCRIPTION The story of the French sailor smock begins with its name. Vareuse comes from the old French verb varer , meaning “to protect” or “to shelter” a clear reference to its original purpose as a hard-wearing layer made for life at sea.
